audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Theorem 2's intransitive scope with a number-field counting exponent is false; Corollary 6 lacks its necessary lower-degree restriction; Corollary 8 is false for k=9, G=S9
limitations: Counterevidence: Separate Theorem 7 suggests intended transitive restriction; changing fields to etale algebras changes the hypothesis.
Counterevidence: Published dependency assumes n>4; high-degree cases not disproved; earlier draft not substituted.
Counterevidence: Does not refute isolated M11 bound; Theorem 7 predicts max exponent9.
Counterevidence: delta=1/(4n^2) satisfies all relevant strict inequalities; partial summation repairs the weighted field count.
Counterevidence: Not asserted to be polynomial counts; a dyadic proof recovers the applications for alpha>0,beta>=0.
Counterevidence: No endpoint group counterexample inferred; sharper inputs can repair; other thresholds pass; non-elemental corrected denominator still sufficient.
Unresolved limits: Journal-final identity remains unestablished.
Unresolved limits: The regular M11 realization theorem and Hilbert irreducibility are used as external established inputs; their full proofs were not independently reconstructed.
Unresolved limits: No formal proof of all source theorems or hypothetical negative-logarithm cases.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.
